[1 media attachment] Added to the log: Note IV: First day of vacation, back at the keyboard

First day of vacation and I already missed the computer. Poking around random repos, I found cobalt, a great media downloader that doesn't work as advertised when self-hosted. The fixes are scattered across community forks, so I put them together in one ready-to-run repo.

https://pablomurad.com/note-iv-cobalt/

#note #cobalt #SelfHosting #docker
